title: Securing Switch Management with SSH
summary: Configure secure administrative access to a Cisco Catalyst switch using SSHv2, RSA key generation, local user authentication, and disabled Telnet transport.
learning_objectives: Configure IP domain name and generate RSA cryptographic keys on Cisco IOS
Configure a local administrative user account with encrypted secret
Configure VTY lines to enforce SSH version 2 and disallow unencrypted Telnet sessions
Verify secure SSH administrative sessions from a remote management client
